IA-01.name: General UI standards
rules: Language consistency: Entire UI in Vietnamese (except standard technical terms)
Color consistency: Positive/Submit actions use blue; Destructive/Cancel actions use red
Currency consistency: Always use '₫' with thousands separator
Page heading: Each page has exactly one <h1> tag describing page content
Tab order: Focus order via Tab key moves top-to-bottom, left-to-right

IA-02.name: Forms
rules: Required fields must have '*' symbol next to the label
Error messages must appear ABOVE the submit button, not below
Multi-step forms (>=2 steps) must have a clear Step Indicator

IA-03.name: Navigation
rules: Navbar must highlight the currently active page
Cart link must display a badge with the item count in cart
Logout button must be labeled 'Đăng xuất' (not 'Thoát')

IA-04.name: Feedback / state
rules: Visual feedback (toast/badge) after clicking 'Add to cart'
Empty state must include an icon/illustration and friendly message
All images must have descriptive non-empty alt attributes
